{{Top|leg}}
A '''line''' was the basic formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Lines were commanded by [[Captain/Legends|captains]] of the line. The line was generally intended to be comprised of four [[Starship/Legends|starships]], although in reality, only seven percent of naval lines were made up of four ships. Lines could be as small as a single vessel, or made up of twenty or more vessels. A [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was considered to be a line all by itself.
